headline: Bernard Arnault's succession, the elephant in the room at LVMH
description: 'Bernard Arnault's Empire' (6/6). The head of the luxury group deliberately raised his five children so that each one could potentially succeed him. While the family presents a united front, the struggle for succession continues behind the scenes.

headline: Trump returns to White House press dinner months after shooting chaos
description: On Friday, President Donald Trump is set to give a speech at the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, which in April had ended in chaos when a California man allegedly attempted to assassinate the president.

headline: Dior's hanging garden in July 2012
description: 'Behind the scenes' (3/6). Fashion shows are often opportunities for particularly spectacular staging, and for the houses, they are key moments. In July 2012, Belgian designer Raf Simons covered entire walls with fresh flowers for his first show at Dior.

headline: OpenLux: How Luxembourg became China's financial gateway to Europe
description: Beijing has used Luxembourg to invest tens of billions of euros on a massive scale. By acquiring leading technology companies and strategic real estate, it has woven a network that challenges European sovereignty.

description: While the city near the border with Switzerland draws a significant part of its income from tourism, the excesses of the industry, including packed beaches, long lines and a surge in Airbnb rentals, have increasingly frustrated residents.
